title: Corey Haines' CRO playbook: diagnosing why a marketing page isn't converting
summary: An AI-agent skill Corey wrote for conversion rate optimization. It ranks seven page dimensions by impact (value prop first, friction last), gives page-type frameworks, and structures output as quick wins, high-impact changes, test ideas and copy alternatives.

principles.text: Fix value proposition clarity first; it is the highest-impact dimension, judged by whether a visitor gets it in 5 seconds.
principles.quote: Can a visitor understand what this is and why they should care within 5 seconds?

principles.text: Headlines should be outcome-focused, specific, and match the traffic source's messaging.
Use one clear primary CTA, and write button copy that communicates value rather than generic action.
principles.quote: Weak: "Submit," "Sign Up," "Learn More" - Strong: "Start Free Trial," "Get My Report," "See Pricing"

principles.text: Place trust signals near CTAs and right after benefit claims, using specific, attributed proof with real numbers.
principles.quote: **Placement:** Near CTAs and after benefit claims

principles.text: Landing pages need message match with the traffic source, a single CTA, and a complete argument on one page.
Handle objections (price, fit, implementation, risk) directly through FAQs, guarantees, comparisons and process transparency.
principles.quote: **Address through:** FAQ sections, guarantees, comparison content, process transparency
